name: Wada
challenge: Palghar's unpredictable drought cycles were forcing the farm to over-irrigate as a precaution, wasting up to 40% of applied water. Without granular soil data, farmers were making irrigation decisions blindly, resulting in inconsistent produce quality across the 6 micro-terroir zones and year-on-year yield variance of ±28%.
solution: HariLeaf installed Soil-DNA Analytics sensors across all  zones, feeding real-time chemical composition data into predictive models. LeafSense AI Vision cameras mounted on end-of-row posts monitor canopy health, UV exposure, and early disease signatures. Data is unified in a single dashboard updated every 15 minutes.
farmerQuote: We went from guessing at irrigation to knowing exactly what each row of vines needs, hour by hour. Our water bill is down 72% and the produce have never been more consistent.
